$description: Classes going away (VERSIONING.md, Deprecation; issue 882). They keep working until they are removed, no earlier than the next minor release, with one exception: the five listed under `until` are promised until 2.0.0 (the 0.84 changelog) and are not removed before it. Eight others (plx-u-absolute, -bg-transparent, -justify-center, -text-center, -top-0, -w-100px, -w-36px, -w-72px) are removed once the connected application CTM has moved off them (CTM#144, PDS#735); the removal reads this file, so it takes only `classes` that are not under `until`. Check-style fails on a new use of any listed class (rule deprecated-classes). The tokens going away carry $deprecated in their token file instead. The 308 classes listed here before the release after 0.90.0 were removed in #723 (issue 125; the list is in the changelog's Removed section).
